changelog_text: - Updated to Android 15 QPR1 (AP4A), security patch level 2024-12-05
- Applied 'Allow spoofing signingInfo for microG Companion/Services' (Gerrit)
- Applied pending LineageOS libperfmgr updates, catching up with Pixels (Gerrit)
- Updated NXP NFC firmware (Gerrit)
- Introduced work-in-progress reverse-engineered improveTouch HAL (GitHub)
Note: does not include Tomoms' optimizations; very much a pure experience
- Another test build; please test with 360 camera if available
- Dropped seemingly unused libs again; could break things
- Includes new PDF Viewer and various app updates
- Security patch level still November 5, 2024
- Includes upcoming Twelve music player and pending review changes
- Feedback requested on whether changes affect battery life
- Feedback requested on 360 camera performance
- Hotspot: if non-functional, toggle 'Extend Compatibility' modes
- VoLTE may cause crashes; disable temporarily if needed
- Notes also apply to oddsolutions.us builds
- Optimised props
- Fixed log spam
- Applied temporary fix for download files in Jelly
- Sync with latest LineageOS sources
- Fixed accessing the Internet
Note: This build should really be considered a demo as accessing the Internet isn't possible yet, we will fix this asap.
